mail.footer:
This is an automated message. Please do not reply: this address does not receive incoming messages.
To contact the organizers, email hackudc@gpul.org.

verify.subject: Verify your hackOS email
verify.body:
Hi {{name}},

Welcome to hackOS! Confirm your email address to continue with your application:

[Verify email]({{verifyUrl}})

If you didn't request this, ignore this message.

verifySecondaryEmail.subject: Confirm your secondary email for hackOS
verifySecondaryEmail.body:
Hi {{name}},

Your hackOS account ({{primaryEmail}}) asked to add {{secondaryEmail}} as a secondary address, so we can match your Devpost projects to your account:

[Confirm {{secondaryEmail}}]({{verifyUrl}})

If you didn't request this, ignore this message — your account won't change.

reset.subject: Reset your hackOS password
reset.body:
Hi {{name}},

You can choose a new password here:

[Reset password]({{resetUrl}})

If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email — your password hasn't changed.

accountRemovalPin.subject: Confirm your hackOS account removal
accountRemovalPin.body:
Hi {{name}},

Your security PIN for removing your hackOS account is:

{{pin}}

This PIN expires in {{expiresMinutes}} minutes. If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email.

invite.subject: You're invited to hackOS
invite.body:
Hi,

You’ve been invited to hackOS. We’re glad to have you joining us. Create your account to accept the invitation:

[Create account]({{claimUrl}})

When you create your account, you’ll choose your password and fill in your details.

invite.subject: You've been invited to join {{projectName}}
invite.body:
Hi,

{{inviterName}} invited you to join their project {{projectName}} on hackOS.

Open My Project to accept or decline the invite.

called.subject: Your team was called
called.body:
Hi {{name}},

Your team {{teamName}} was called for {{challengeName}}. Go to the door of room {{roomName}} and wait outside. Do not enter yet.

precall.subject: Get ready: we'll call you soon
precall.body:
Hi {{name}},

Your team {{teamName}} will be called soon for {{challengeName}}. Get ready, but do not go to the room yet. Approximate time: {{etaMinutes}} minutes.

enter.subject: Come on in
enter.body:
Hi {{name}},

Enter room {{roomName}} now. It is your team's turn for {{challengeName}}.

message.subject: Message about {{challengeName}}

enter.subject: Team entering {{roomName}}
enter.body: {{teamName}} was asked to enter room {{roomName}} for {{challengeName}}.

called.subject: Team called for {{roomName}}
called.body: {{teamName}} was called to wait at the door of room {{roomName}} for {{challengeName}}.

decision.subject: A decision on your application
decision.body:
Hi {{name}},

We’ve reviewed your application to {{applicationName}}.{{decisionDetails}}

accepted.subject: Your spot at {{applicationName}} is waiting for you!
accepted.heading: We can’t wait to see you at {{applicationName}}!

rejected.subject: About your application to {{applicationName}}
rejected.body:
Hi {{name}},

Unfortunately, your application to {{applicationName}} hasn’t been selected this time. We know this isn’t the news you were hoping for.

Thank you for your interest and for the time you put into your application. We hope to see you at a future edition.

Best wishes,
The organizing team

decision.confirmationDetails:
{{deadlineNotice}}

[Confirm my spot]({{confirmUrl}})

If you can’t make it, please let us know so someone else can take your place:

[Decline my spot]({{declineUrl}})

If you don’t confirm within that time, your spot will be released automatically.
decision.confirmationDeadline: You can confirm your spot until {{deadline}}.

reminder.subject: Reminder: {{title}}

precall.title: Get ready: we’ll call you soon
precall.body: Do not go to the room yet. We’ll call {{teamName}} for {{challengeName}} in about {{etaMinutes}} minutes.

called.title: Go to the door of {{roomName}}
called.body: Wait outside for {{challengeName}}. Do not enter until we tell you to.
